ValidationRule.description: #10773 : Book to Bill: Update Permissions to allow Implementation Team to Move Deals from Stage 5 to 6 & Stage 6 to 7 #21200-Making the VR applicable for all profiles except Admins #21201-Users with permissionset Move Opportunity to Stage 7 are bypassed
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
ISCHANGED( StageName ),
ISPICKVAL( StageName , '7 - Closed'),
$Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", $Profile.Name <> "IM_Custom Sys Admin",
$Setup.ValidationRuleException__c.RunRule__c,
$Permission.NCSP_NAS_Blended = FALSE,
NOT( $Permission.Update_Stage_of_Closed_Opportunities ), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to update an Opportunity to Stage 7. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
